title: Bind Staging Recovery external source authenticity to a signed acquisition authority

phases.objective: Replace the static external-acquisition gate with a server-branded Ed25519 receipt authority, add canonical Network/OAuth/Registration producers, keep Registration and unavailable OAuth acquisition fail-closed, and require receipt verification before canary, countersign, signing, and readiness.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Validate signed receipt authority and exercise PR-B1 fail-closed external acquisition boundaries
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Network acquisition can verify, OAuth correlation contract is enforced, registration source authenticity remains unavailable, no live receipt is signed, and no canary/countersign/readiness path can be opened by caller flags or fabricated JSON.
steps: Construct server-branded acquisition authority from dedicated Ed25519 public trust.
Verify receipt signature, key identity, exact SHA/target, TTL, evidence hashes and source-proof hashes.
Reject key reuse with Activation Gateway ingress or Recovery certification trust.

Validate same-request Network acquisition using direct trusted-ingress 403, Gateway 2xx, and exact live Gateway health identity bound to expected SHA, Worker build SHA, canonical policy hash, no-secret status, and Worker bundle hash.
Validate ordered no-secret OAuth server-correlation events and redirect-URI hash binding.
Keep ChatGPT registration source verification unavailable even when registration parity is valid.
Require acquisition receipt transport before local canary and independent countersign.
Confirm The consolidated Staging Post-Deploy Verification acquisition operation records OAuth/Registration blockers and never consumes the private acquisition key on the blocked path.
assertions: No environment flag, caller verified field, manual JSON or operator acknowledgement can manufacture acquisition authority.
A direct-origin generic or host-isolation 404 cannot sign PR-B1 acquisition authority; the explicit trusted-ingress 403 is required.

Network acquisition cannot label a newer expected SHA onto an older live Gateway: health sourceCommit and workerBuildSha must equal the exact candidate SHA and health policyHash must equal the canonical Staging policy.
OAuth token, authorization-code, credential or secret fields are rejected.
Registration parity without provider/source attestation cannot produce a signed acquisition receipt.
Acquisition and certification signing keys remain separate from Gateway ingress trust.
Production mutation, provider mutation and database mutation remain prohibited.
